LETTER AGREEMENT - HOSPITAL SERVICES RATES AND
TERMS
Date: 17th day of August, 2025
This letter agreement sets out how Pinecrest Medical Plan (the Plan) will reimburse Northgate Family
Physicians (the Provider) for covered services given to the Plan's members. It replaces the parties' earlier
arrangement dated August 17, 2022, under which clean claims were paid within 30 days and acute inpatient
care was paid at $3,875 per day. Those earlier terms no longer apply.
Rates. Starting on 17th day of August, 2025, the Plan will pay a flat per diem of $3,975 for each day of acute
medical/surgical inpatient care, and one hundred fifty (150) percent of the Medicare fee schedule for general
outpatient services. Behavioral health inpatient stays are paid at $4,275 per day, and emergency department
visits at 165 percent of Medicare.

Payment and filing. The Plan will pay each clean claim within fifteen (15) days after it receives the claim.
The Provider must send claims no later than one hundred eighty (180) days after the date of service. A
denied claim may be appealed within 270 days.
Credentialing. The Plan will finish credentialing the Provider's clinicians within sixty (60) days of getting a
complete application.
Duration. This letter agreement begins on the 17th day of August, 2025, runs for four years, and ends on the
16th day of August, 2029. At the end of that period it will roll over from year to year unless one side gives
notice of non-renewal 30 days ahead. Either side may end it early, without cause, by giving sixty (60) days
written notice.

Law. This letter agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Colorado.
Insurance and records. The Provider will carry professional liability cover of $2,000,000 per occurrence and
keep records for 7 years.
Please countersign below to confirm that this reflects our agreement.
